name: NioCorp Developments
verdict: STARTER-GATED on the FY26 10-K (~2026-09-10/11, EDGAR-precedent-dated: FY25 10-K filed 9/11/25; pack's 9/28 wrong) — NO position today. After the 10-K clears THREE named items -> RP_FAIR starter 0.25% (floor; blue proposed 0.4%, floor held for the duration-bet label): (i) the $8.4M business-combination note is arm's-length and benign (neither bench examined it — common_control_merger_accounting live), (ii) FY26 recurring investing+operating burn <=~$45M/yr (blue's decomposed rate; red's $52.7M included the one-time acquisition), (iii) cover share count confirms ~153.4M practical FD (blue overturned red's 164.7M — pre-funded warrants were ALREADY exercised into the count by 3/4/26, red double-counted).
conviction: red 4/10 on its own kill case (ACCEPT-WITH-CUTS), blue 6/10 starter-after-10-K — convergent: NO FATAL exists; the funded prize clears +50% even at scandium ZERO, post-dilution ($7.85/sh at 293M shares vs $6.96 hurdle)
kill_class_census: 2 NOVEL sustained (pilled-serial-diluter path: five raises $3.25-$9.34 in 9mo + 20% pill extended to 2027 + revealed $3.25 reservation price = duration bet against a permanent equity seller; Sc volume line = 118 t/yr vs ~40 t world production, 3x world supply, only a 15 t/yr non-binding Lockheed MOU) / 5 CONSENSUS / 2 OVERTURNED (denominator double-count; burn run-rate contamination). Red's scandium PRICE attack REFUTED by blue: the FS deck is $1,964/kg — roughly HALF the $3,500-5,500/kg spot band; the study already embeds the elasticity haircut red demanded.
audit_notes: Blue's corrections primary-sourced (FS release 8/10; 10-Q investing decomposition: $19.2M capex + $8.4M acquisition + $49k deposits). Runner pack-misquote WARN on red's tape framing audited: red declared supersession to the 8/21 close ($4.64) with recomputed anchors — legitimate, conservative direction. EXIM gap ruled a RANGE $262-664M (39-98% of mcap), company itself 'unable to estimate' — the low end is our arithmetic, not EXIM's.
structure_rules: NO GTC EVER (ATM-restart risk — the board has issued at every price incl. $3.25); DAY-only entries post-10-K; explicitly labeled DURATION BET AGAINST A PERMANENT EQUITY SELLER; unlevered; sleeve-capped in materials beside AAUC/PHYS.
proposed_order: NONE today — event-gated; stage 0.25% (~590 sh at ~$4.40s) only after the 10-K three-item clearance

narratives: Tripwire-less (unknown-unknown: the unexamined $8.4M business combination) — the 10-K reveals a related-party or asset-quality problem inside a transaction neither bench opened, and the gate we designed to admit us admits a taint instead.

The prize table is right and irrelevant: EXIM never converts the LOI, and every year of delay is another $40M raised into the tape at whatever price prevails — the NPV compounds at 8% while the share count compounds faster.

Reflexive: our gate is the 10-K, but the board can raise BEFORE it (they have five times in nine months) — a pre-print offering at $4 would both confirm the thesis's kill and destroy the entry the gate was protecting.
premortem.sentence: If this position loses money, the most likely reason will be that we correctly computed a five-times funded prize and underestimated that the board would sell it to us a tranche at a time — dilution arriving faster than the project de-risks, forever.
